instruction_bn: বন্ধু/আত্মীয়কে একটি informal letter/email লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 10 marks)।

items.prompt: Write a letter to your friend inviting him to visit your village.
items.model:
Dhaka
10 May 2026

Dear Sabbir,
Take my warm love. I received your letter yesterday and was glad to know that you are well. In this letter I want to invite you to visit my village.

My village is a small but beautiful place on the bank of a river. There are green fields, shady trees and ponds full of fish. In the evening a gentle breeze blows over the fields. I am sure you will enjoy the calm and natural beauty of my village. We can go boating on the river and walk through the green paddy fields together.

So, please come to my village during the coming vacation and spend a few days with me. Convey my regards to your parents.

Your loving friend,
Rahim
rubric: 'Your loving friend' + নাম দিয়ে শেষ করেছি

items.prompt: Write a letter to your younger brother advising him to give up bad company.
items.model:
Dhaka
10 May 2026

Dear Sohel,
Take my love. I have heard from our mother that you have made friends with some boys of bad character. I am very worried to know this, so I am writing to advise you.

Bad company is like a disease. It spoils a boy's character and future. If you mix with bad boys, you will lose your interest in study and pick up bad habits. Our parents have great hopes about you. So, please give up such company at once. Mix with good and hardworking boys and give all your attention to your studies.

I believe you will follow my advice. Give my salam to our parents.

Your affectionate brother,
Kamal
rubric: 'Your affectionate brother' + নাম দিয়ে শেষ করেছি

items.prompt: Write a letter to your friend describing your school/college.
items.model:
Dhaka
10 May 2026

Dear Karim,
Many thanks for your kind letter. In your letter you wanted to know about my college. So, I am writing about it.

My college is one of the best colleges in our town. It is situated in a calm and healthy place. It has a big three-storeyed building with many spacious classrooms. There is also a rich library, a science laboratory and a large playground. The teachers of my college are highly qualified and very affectionate. They teach us with great care. Every year our college achieves brilliant results in the public examinations. I am proud to be a student of this college.

No more today. Convey my regards to your parents.

Your loving friend,
Jamil
rubric: 'Your loving friend' + নাম দিয়ে শেষ করেছি

items.prompt: Write a letter to your younger sister advising her to be punctual.
items.model:

Dear Runa,
Take my love. I have learnt from mother that you are not punctual in your work these days. You do not get up early and often go to school late. I am writing to advise you about this.

I hope you will follow my advice and become a punctual girl. Give my salam to our parents.

Dear Fahim,
Take my love. In this letter I want to tell you about the Ekushey Book Fair which I visited last week.

The fair is held every year in February at the Bangla Academy in Dhaka. It was decorated with hundreds of stalls full of colourful books. Writers, publishers and readers of all ages gathered there. I found books on almost every subject, such as stories, novels, poems and science. I moved from stall to stall and bought some storybooks. There was a huge crowd, yet everything was well arranged. I enjoyed the day very much.

I wish you had been with me. Convey my regards to your parents.

Your loving friend,

items.prompt: Write a letter to your friend about the importance of reading newspapers.

items.prompt: Write a letter to your friend describing how you helped flood-affected people.
items.model:
Dhaka

Dear Junaid,
Take my love. In this letter I want to tell you how I and my friends helped the flood-affected people of our area last month.

This year a severe flood washed away the crops and houses of many people. They became homeless and passed their days without food and pure water. Seeing their misery, we formed a small group of volunteers. We collected money, clothes, dry food and medicine from the well-off people. Then we went to the flood-hit area and distributed the relief among the affected families. Their happy faces gave us great satisfaction.

Such service to suffering people is a noble work. Convey my regards to your parents.
